snippet.title: ServiceIT: You can do IT - Full Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
ServiceIT: You can do IT, a game about fixing electronics⚡️, managing an IT company📈, and fighting off hackers💻, is finally coming out of Early Access.

On the 15th of September, ServiceIT: You can do IT is getting a FULL RELEASE along with a MAJOR UPDATE.

Grab it on Steam and start your IT adventure now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2194730/ServiceIT_You_can_do_IT/

#serviceit #pcgaming #simulator
